comments.author: Melfely
comments.body_html:
So something I did do was limit the ranges it extended to BASED ON the current scopes pre existing max range. (I think it extends it by 100M or so) because, having up to 800M on the 1-4x scopes was annoying.

If you want to, go to the GITHUB link and you can clone the project then, change the variable


const double MAX_EXTRA_SIGHTING_DISTANCE = 100; //This is a flat extra sighting distance adjustement to scopes, giving them better useability, but not giving EVERY Scope 2k meters worth of sighting distance...

Then you can recompile and it will change how much extra extension range the scopes get above their vanilla range.
